view_labels.model_visible: fields/labels readable from named manifests/summaries at the boundary or in v14 package files
view_labels.archive_only: address/archive-only unless known at cutoff: full event_script/scene_setup, future fault and weather schedules, terminal/hidden control, semantic episode names
view_labels.known_plan_experiments: explicit known-plan experiments carry separate labels and are never counted as observed model-visible history

lp_definition_ids.q_derived: definition_id=p09.LP.q-derived/v1 (old q-based scalar L/P; source distribution/statistics not demonstrated per root causal summary)
lp_definition_ids.mature_ttl_cohort: definition_id=p09.LP.mature-ttl-cohort/v1 (native ns3 receipt cohort; strict RX<firstTX+TTL; count actual available_time<=cutoff; no timely RX means L undefined, never zero; incomplete compute tasks remain pending/right-censored without hindsight outcomes)
lp_definition_ids.rule: distinct definition_id per L/P family; count only actual available_time<=cutoff; no timely RX -> L undefined (never zero); incomplete compute tasks remain pending/right-censored without hindsight outcomes

count_group_1_identity_alignment.definition: episode set agreement across published index (210), archive manifest (210), change table (210), v14 original210 references (210); 70 scenarios x seeds 0/1/2; duplicates none

count_group_2_per_dimension_specific_out.definition: rows citing an episode-specific artifact whose path exists (existence level, not content)

count_group_3_actual_consumer_confirmed.definition: actual_consumer_confirmed counts ONLY rows with positive per-episode consumption evidence (an actual run/capture receipt naming the episode and artifact). Registry entries, contract statements and config pointers are NEVER actual runtime consumption: configured pointers, path existence, registry/contract/config-pointer claims are counted separately and NEVER enter this group
count_group_3_actual_consumer_confirmed.actual_consumer_confirmed: 0 rows (ACTUAL_RUN_RECEIPTS empty: no per-episode consumption receipt exists)
count_group_3_actual_consumer_confirmed.actual_capture_binding: 0 rows (ACTUAL_CAPTURE_RECEIPTS empty: no same-run pose/weather/clock capture receipt exists)
count_group_3_actual_consumer_confirmed.configured_pointer_note: persisted UE example config points to aw_data/rebuild_l1_1_radius10_20260918/...; pointer presence only
count_group_3_actual_consumer_confirmed.documented_corpus_or_contract_level_note: corpus/contract statements backed by read named documents; neither actual-run nor capture evidence

count_group_4_adopted_version_confirmed.definition: rows citing a version confirmed adopted by actual consumer entrances (release materialized, not planned)
count_group_4_adopted_version_confirmed.evidence: current_episode_change_table.csv: release_adoption=NO_CANDIDATE_ADOPTED for 204/210; the 6 L6-2_v1/v2 episodes carry PLAN_ADOPTED_PENDING_COMBINED_RELEASE_FREEZE with candidate_status=COMPLETED, planned_adoption=PLAN_ADOPTED_RECAPTURE_REQUIRED, release_modified_by_this_work=False — planned, not a materialized adopted version
count_group_4_adopted_version_confirmed.supporting: adoption_configuration.json adopted_as_final_workload=false and adopted_render_versions=false; v14 is technical-input candidate only

count_group_4b_split_group_alignment.definition: episodes grouped by base scenario family (scenario_id minus _vN); ORIGINAL scenario+seed and all versions/overlays/load branches/windows share one split_group; new-scenario generalization claims require the ENTIRE base family across ALL seeds held out

count_group_4c_v14_package_vs_producer_r.definition: v14 package label (36 episodes x 8 dimensions inherited) is NOT a producer revision; actual revised files are mapped from projection_receipt.json file lists

dimensions_with_changed_producer_files.weather/environment: v12 weather.jsonl authored schedule (30 eps; 6 L6-2 eps list no weather file)

projection_configured_not_produced: perception/capture (render_host_config + planned capture_window.json; UE capture not run)

missing_mapping.reason: no episode-level consumer mapping exists in any read source; pending_check states the open question per row

missing_coverage_statistics.reason: camera/LiDAR sidecar clock/extrinsic fields presence-verified only (validity unaudited); no per-frame occlusion ground truth; per-episode capture_tick lists verified 1/210

real_mechanism_gap.reason: scalar model or typed state without a physical mechanism (root causal summary): comm/compute = 1.6.0 scalar model; GNSS/weather/facility = typed states; ns3/R1/v9/business candidates exist only as versioned outputs outside the formal 210

count_group_5_pending_grouped._note: buckets are dimension-based and may overlap across buckets; every counted row carries exactly one specific pending_check

dispositions.other: empty with exactly one specific pending_check (per assignment rule)
